name: Monke Abyss
summary: In Monke Abyss, there are many things to do. You can go to the gamemode selection and play different minigames, ranging from an intense combat, to a calming collection game. Or, you could go to the collectibles area, which showcases the collectibles you earned throughout these minigames, and some quick games, like a button clicker. You will never be bored when playing Monke Abyss!
